description: One DELETE of the 300 lowest keys (ID <= 300) of the primary-key index of IxM. Asks what happens to the index pages, the leaf's entries and the statistic when a large run of entries is removed. IxM: 602 Long primary-key entries (1..301 and 303..603), no other column. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
